'''Pon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who acted as one of the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After Sinasu became embroiled in a gang war with the rival Hutt [[Noako]], agents of Noako torched Sinasu's [[Greentop Tower]] docking station on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and Pon was badly burnt in the attack. Sinasu went into hiding in [[TechTank shop|the base]] of the [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] gang [[TechTank]] and Pon betrayed her employer's location to [[Cordol's Chain]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] group in the employ of Noako, which subsequently commenced an attack on the TechTank facility.
